tags.name: Identity and access
tags.description: Digital identities, accounts, credentials, identity proofing, authentication, federation, authorization, and logical access policy.
tags.definition: Digital identities, accounts, credentials, identity proofing, authentication, federation, authorization, and logical access policy.
exclusionRules: Cryptographic authentication tags or codes whose subject is the primitive.
Acronyms that only resemble identity protocols.

tags.name: Cryptography
tags.description: Cryptographic primitives, encryption, hashes and MACs, signatures, key exchange and management, PKI and certificates, secure randomness, cryptanalysis, supporting infrastructure, and cryptographic failures.
tags.definition: Cryptographic primitives, encryption, hashes and MACs, signatures, key exchange and management, PKI and certificates, secure randomness, cryptanalysis, supporting infrastructure, and cryptographic failures.
inclusionRules: Cryptographic protocols when cryptography is substantive.
exclusionRules: Lexical uses of key or signature.
Ordinary protocols where cryptography is incidental.

tags.name: Network security
tags.description: Protection, monitoring, segmentation, filtering, and defense of networks and network communications.
tags.definition: Protection, monitoring, segmentation, filtering, and defense of networks and network communications.
inclusionRules: Attacks or weaknesses whose network mechanism is substantive.
exclusionRules: Generic networking, routing, addressing, sockets, and protocol definitions.

tags.name: Threats and adversary behavior
tags.description: Cybersecurity threats, actors, campaigns, TTPs, techniques, social engineering, indicators, attribution, and threat-intelligence artifacts whose substantive subject is adversarial activity.
tags.definition: Cybersecurity threats, actors, campaigns, TTPs, techniques, social engineering, indicators, attribution, and threat-intelligence artifacts whose substantive subject is adversarial activity.
inclusionRules: Threat-intelligence concepts about acquiring, analyzing, or sharing adversary information.
exclusionRules: General risk or weakness without a specific threat subject.
Defenses whose primary subject belongs elsewhere.

tags.name: Vulnerabilities and remediation
tags.description: Cybersecurity weaknesses and exposures, plus their identification, cataloging, assessment, prioritization, and resolution.
tags.definition: Cybersecurity weaknesses and exposures, plus their identification, cataloging, assessment, prioritization, and resolution.
inclusionRules: Vulnerabilities, weaknesses, insecure designs, and misconfiguration.
CVE, CWE, CVSS, and vulnerability catalogs.
exclusionRules: Adversary behavior that does not make an underlying weakness substantive.
Malware as an artifact rather than a weakness.

tags.name: Malware
tags.description: Malicious software, its families, lifecycle, capabilities, delivery, execution, malware-specific persistence, analysis, detection, and removal.
tags.definition: Malicious software, its families, lifecycle, capabilities, delivery, execution, malware-specific persistence, analysis, detection, and removal.
inclusionRules: Analysis, detection, disinfection, and removal when malware remains the substantive topic.
exclusionRules: Threat behavior, infrastructure, or evasion that merely mentions malware.
Threat actors and campaigns without malicious software as a substantive subject.

tags.name: Incident response
tags.description: Preparation for, investigation of, triage of, containment of, eradication of, recovery from, and learning after cybersecurity incidents.
tags.definition: Preparation for, investigation of, triage of, containment of, eradication of, recovery from, and learning after cybersecurity incidents.
inclusionRules: Detection and alert triage in incident context.
Digital forensics and evidence handling tied to cybersecurity investigation.
exclusionRules: Ordinary account, data, or key recovery.
Business continuity and disaster recovery without incident context.

tags.name: Risk and governance
tags.description: Cybersecurity risk, governance, policy, compliance, authorization, audit, and program assurance.
tags.definition: Cybersecurity risk, governance, policy, compliance, authorization, audit, and program assurance.
exclusionRules: Cryptographic module or key-management policy whose primary subject is cryptography.
Identity mechanisms that adapt to risk.

tags.name: Privacy and data protection
tags.description: Privacy risk and responsible processing, protection, minimization, consent, identifiability, and de-identification of personal data.
tags.definition: Privacy risk and responsible processing, protection, minimization, consent, identifiability, and de-identification of personal data.
exclusionRules: Cryptographic products whose names contain privacy.
Privacy roles and job titles by type alone.

tags.name: Supply-chain security
tags.description: Cybersecurity risk and compromise across products, services, suppliers, dependencies, acquisition, provenance, and delivery chains.
tags.definition: Cybersecurity risk and compromise across products, services, suppliers, dependencies, acquisition, provenance, and delivery chains.
inclusionRules: Product and service acquisition and supplier security.
SBOM and software or hardware component provenance.
exclusionRules: Generic vendors, suppliers, and third parties.

tags.name: Physical and environmental security
tags.description: Physical access, facilities, media, environmental hazards, emanations, and physical tamper protection as they relate to information-system security.
tags.definition: Physical access, facilities, media, environmental hazards, emanations, and physical tamper protection as they relate to information-system security.
exclusionRules: Cyber-physical or operational technology as a platform.
Physical-medium exfiltration when adversary behavior is the subject.

retiredTags.name: Access control
retiredTags.reason: Renamed into the broader identity and access contract in taxonomy v2.

retiredTags.name: Threat intelligence
retiredTags.reason: Expanded into the threats and adversary behavior contract in taxonomy v2.

retiredTags.name: Vulnerability management
retiredTags.reason: Expanded into the vulnerabilities and remediation contract in taxonomy v2.

retiredTags.name: Protocols
retiredTags.reason: Retired without a successor because protocol identity alone is not a cybersecurity topic.
